hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+commit' && (printf '%s' "$c" | grep -oE "\-m\s+'[^']*'|\-m\s+\"[^\"]*\"" | sed "s/^-m[[:space:]]*['\"]//;s/['\"]$//" | sed 's/CLAUDE\.md//g;s/\.claude\///g' | grep -iqE 'claude|anthropic|co-authored-by|generated with|claude-session|claude\.ai|claude\.com|anthropic\.com') && jq -nc '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Attribution detected in the git commit message. The project instructions forbid ANY reference to the tool, the vendor, Co-Authored-By, Generated with, Claude-Session, or claude.ai/claude.com/anthropic.com in commit messages. Naming the repo files CLAUDE.md or .claude/ is fine and is not what tripped this. Strip every such line and retry."}}' || true

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+commit' && { [ "$(git config user.email)" != "peter@hernandez.id.au" ] || [ "$(git config user.name)" != "Peter Hernandez" ]; } && jq -nc '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Commit author is not Peter Hernandez <peter@hernandez.id.au>. CLAUDE.md requires every commit to be authored by me, not by the default identity of the agent environment. Run: git config user.name \"Peter Hernandez\" && git config user.email \"peter@hernandez.id.au\" then commit again. Do not use --author, --reset-author or -c user.* to work around it."}}' || true

jq -r '(.tool_input.body // .tool_input.text // "") + " " + (.tool_input.title // "")' | sed 's/CLAUDE\.md//g;s/\.claude\///g' | grep -iqE 'claude|anthropic|co-authored-by|generated with|claude-session|claude\.ai|claude\.com|anthropic\.com' && jq -nc '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Attribution detected in the PR or comment. The project instructions forbid ANY reference to the tool, the vendor, Generated with, Claude-Session, or claude.ai/claude.com/anthropic.com in PR titles, bodies and comments. Naming the repo files CLAUDE.md or .claude/ is fine and is not what tripped this. Strip it and retry."}}' || true

git log -1 --format=%B | sed 's/CLAUDE\.md//g;s/\.claude\///g' | grep -iqE 'claude|anthropic|co-authored-by|generated with|claude-session|claude\.ai|claude\.com|anthropic\.com' && jq -nc '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Attribution guard: the commit about to be pushed carries attribution, most likely inserted by tooling. Strip every reference from the commit message and try again."}}' || true
